takeaway: The sternal angle is at T4: the aortic arch is ending, the azygos vein enters the superior vena cava and the pulmonary trunk may be seen dividing.

lines.text: After a chest injury, which statement about the level of the sternal angle is true?
The sternal angle lies at the level of T4.
lines.say: The sternal angle lies at the level of T four.

lines.text: At this level the azygos vein enters the superior vena cava,
the aortic arch is ending, not beginning, and the pulmonary trunk may be seen dividing.
So a section at the sternal angle shows the T4 vertebral body.
lines.say: So a section at the sternal angle shows the T four vertebral body.

lines.text: The answer: it demonstrates the T4 vertebral body.
lines.say: (clears throat) The answer: it demonstrates the T four vertebral body.
